Taco Tuesday Ride (Wheel Suckers)

Chandler, AZ · Road

Taco Tuesday Ride (Wheel Suckers) is a road group ride in Chandler, AZ. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Fiesta Mexicana Restaurant. About 21.5 (A and B routes), 18.5 (C route) miles, a group 20+ mph, B group 18+ mph, C group 16+ mph.

For visitors

Lights are required, plus helmet and repair supplies. The host runs a pre-ride huddle on safety and the route. Food and drinks follow at the start restaurant. Wheel Suckers' site lists a ride waiver. The Meetup post calls it a no-drop road ride but also lists an A group; the Wheel Suckers site says the A group is a drop ride and the C group is no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a group 20+ mph, B group 18+ mph, C group 16+ mph. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Taco Tuesday Ride (Wheel Suckers) group ride

A Tuesday-evening road ride of about 21 miles that ends with tacos and drinks. Wheel Suckers and Global Bikes run it together in A, B and C groups, with a shorter C route of 18.5 miles. It's a regular on the Wheel Suckers calendar and the Global Bikes Meetup.
